report.explanation: All services show healthy error_rate 0.0014, p95 73ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; gateway, payment and inventory logs are OK. Only order shows retained_heap_after_gc warnings and 340MB retained memory, but a single short window cannot establish a leak, and no current evidence links it to checkout degradation. Insufficient to name a root cause; hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Sustained memory-retention time series for order service to distinguish a leak from a transient retained-heap warning
Baseline/expected memory_retained_bytes for order service to judge whether 340MB is anomalous
Evidence of user-facing checkout impact (elevated latency or errors) tied to order service memory
Confirmation that order retained-heap warnings correlate with the degraded checkout health alert
